verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an official, documented CLI, `clai`, for chatting with various LLMs from the command line. It can also launch a uvicorn server for browser chat, and any Agent can enter CLI mode via `Agent.to_cli_sync()`; a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of `clai` itself, since the community mentions concern users building their own CLIs rather than using the official one.
